external_sources.verification_boundary: Offline verification checks local evidence only. check_external_sources.py independently retrieved the primary URLs; external_sources.json records current byte identities, paper-manifest equality and retrieval scope.

limitations: Single 100-update seed991 execution per workload/platform; no speedup uncertainty or sustained-rate claim.
Initial float32 hashes differ; matching-recipe timing is not a hardware-only or bitwise-paired comparison.
Mac contention declines as workloads finish; no sequential-concurrency control.

measurement_definitions.checkpoint_timers: full_checkpoint_seconds is from run_status and includes the complete save/signature/record path. checkpoint_record_seconds sums preflight record timing, a narrower scope.
measurement_definitions.cpu: Collector user/system CPU times are cumulative getrusage values including startup CPU; segment wall time excludes startup. Their ratio is approximate capacity use, not interval utilization or Slurm accounting.
measurement_definitions.fractions: All *_fraction_of_segment values use active segment wall seconds. remaining_outside_update_seconds subtracts update and full checkpoint wall time only.
measurement_definitions.initial_signature: Existing named parameter signature metadata, shapes and dtypes are compared without loading a policy. Exactly 36 float32 attention tensor hashes differ per workload; initial float64 hashes match.
measurement_definitions.launcher: Mac timestamps describe launcher lifetime including frozen probes. Stokes archive has no absolute job timestamps or node/CPU model/topology; overlap is not inferred.
measurement_definitions.projected_budget_hours: 40M PP/PCP or 28M FC budget times active segment seconds / recorded environment steps / 3600. Excludes startup and future queue/downtime; assumes unchanged throughput.
measurement_definitions.rss: Sum of individual lifetime collector RSS peaks after converting Linux KiB or macOS bytes; not simultaneous process/job/system memory.
measurement_definitions.update_steps_per_second: Sum of joint environment steps divided by sum of 100 recorded train_batch wall times; includes rollout, backward, IPC, waiting, aggregation and optimizer work.

mutable_document_policy: Current plan/README/AGENTS are deliverables being edited; final document hashes are maintained separately. Prior archived README files remain covered by the 639-file run input inventory.
